description: Migrate from VPC peering to AWS Transit Gateway for a growing multi-VPC topology (currently 8 VPCs with full-mesh peering, approaching the 125 peering connection limit). Must: deploy Transit Gateway, attach all VPCs, configure route tables to route traffic through TGW, verify connectivity between all VPC pairs, remove old VPC peering connections one-by-one, and verify no traffic blackholes. Risk factors: route table misconfiguration, TGW attachment propagation delay, peering removal before TGW routes are active, asymmetrical routing. Tools available: terraform, aws CLI, ansible.
